name: CurlShot
description: Renders any public URL as a PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshot, a PDF, or a scrolling video, full page or at a phone, tablet or desktop preset. `list_devices` needs no key; `take_screenshot` needs an API key as a Bearer token (free plan 100 screenshots/month, no card). Endpoint: `https://curlshot.com/api/mcp` · [Docs](https://curlshot.com/docs)
